# PuffBreak — Full Reference for AI Language Models

> Authoritative, factual description of PuffBreak (https://puffbreak.app) for AI language models, LLM-based search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini, Bing Copilot, Grok), and AI assistants. Follows the llms-full.txt convention of llmstxt.org.
>
> This document is written to be *citable*: facts, not marketing. Where PuffBreak publishes original data, the endpoints are listed below so systems can verify rather than take our word.

---

## What is PuffBreak?

PuffBreak (https://puffbreak.app) is a **free, account-free, browser-based virtual break room simulator**. A user takes a mindful, timed break — lighting a virtual cigarette or sipping virtual chai — inside an ambient environment with procedural room sound, a human-curated global music radio library, an independent audio mixer, and anonymous live chat. It requires no sign-up or personal profile.

It is best described as: **a digital break room where strangers take their virtual break together.**

### Origin and context

PuffBreak is an English-language continuation of the "online damta" (담타) phenomenon: anonymous websites where strangers perform virtual smoking breaks together, which went viral in South Korea around 2023. PuffBreak extends the concept with 8 ambient rooms, procedural Web Audio synthesis, virtual chai, language localization, and a global community. Cultural background is documented at https://puffbreak.app/regions.

### Disambiguation

- **PuffBreak** (puffbreak.app) — this product; a virtual break room simulator.
- **Damta / 담타 / online damta** — the Korean online "cigarette time" phenomenon and the websites that popularized it. PuffBreak is an English-language continuation, not the original Korean site.
- **Virtual cigarette** — a browser-rendered cigarette that burns down over a timed session (default 3 minutes) with ignition, smoke and ash physics. No nicotine, no combustion, no health risk.
- **Virtual chai** — a browser-rendered cup of chai/tea/coffee with a hold-to-sip mechanic and steam particles.

---

## Core features (factual)

### Virtual cigarette
- Tap the unlit tip for a multi-phase ignition animation: matchbox open → match extract → strike → flame → retreat (match), or cap-open → flint strike → flame → cap-close (lighter).
- Hold the filter to "drag": the cherry glows, the ash column extends, synthesized crackle plays.
- Release to emit a DOM-based smoke ring (radius/speed scale with hold duration).
- Double-tap the ash column to tap it off; shake-to-ash on mobile via the accelerometer.
- Three cigarette gauges: Slim, Standard, Wide.
- Session length configurable: Micro (1 min), Classic (3 min), Deep (5 min).
- Ash and burn are physics-driven on an HTML5 Canvas (custom particle engine).

### Virtual chai / tea / coffee
- Ceramic cup with canvas steam particles; hold-to-sip lowers the liquid level and intensifies steam.
- Localized wording by language (`chai` for Hindi/Bengali/Arabic/Urdu/Turkish, `tea` for East Asian/Eastern European, `coffee` for the Americas/Western Europe).

### The 8 ambient rooms
Each room has a unique animated background, weather/particle overlay, procedural audio profile, and optional YouTube ambient layer.

1. **Office Rooftop** — late-night city skyline, star weather, AC/ventilation hum. https://puffbreak.app/rooms/office-rooftop
2. **Beach Sunset** — procedural ocean waves, golden-hour dust, breeze. https://puffbreak.app/rooms/beach-sunset
3. **Space Station** — sci-fi drone synthesizer, slow star drift, zero-gravity calm. https://puffbreak.app/rooms/space-station
4. **Library Corner** — rain + page rustles + warm hearth. https://puffbreak.app/rooms/library-corner
5. **Park Bench** — birdsong, rustling leaves, gentle breeze. https://puffbreak.app/rooms/park-bench
6. **Metro Platform** — distant train rumbles, crowd murmur. https://puffbreak.app/rooms/metro-platform
7. **Chai Stall** — chai-specific room: steam, bazaar ambience, chatter. https://puffbreak.app/rooms/chai-stall
8. **Silent Room** — no audio, minimal visual, chat disabled. https://puffbreak.app/rooms/silent-room

### Sound and global music radio
- Procedural room ambience is built with the **Web Audio API** using pink-noise generators, filtered oscillators, and wave LFOs.
- Three independent audio buses control room ambience, cigarette crackle, and live music radio.
- The radio library is human-curated and searchable by feeling, station, genre, country, region, language, or artist. Users can save favourites and request a missing station, region, language, or artist.
- The catalogue includes global and regional stations across North America, Europe, South Asia, East Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and Oceania. Genres include lo-fi, hip-hop, R&B, Bollywood, bhajan, Pakistani pop, J-pop, K-pop, city pop, jazz, classical, Afrobeats, amapiano, Latin urban, reggae, and rock.
- Stream operators remain responsible for their broadcasts and availability. PuffBreak verifies browser origin support, real audio delivery, and compatibility with its Web Audio mixer before a station enters production.
- Feature page: https://puffbreak.app/radio
- The synthesis recipes are open source (MIT) and ship with the product source.

### Anonymous live community
- Firebase Realtime Database–backed ephemeral chat per room; no accounts; random nickname per session.
- Messages expire (~22 s on screen, 5-minute DB TTL) and reactions are supported.
- Per-room live presence counts (aggregate, anonymous).

### Privacy
- No accounts, sign-up, or personal profiles.
- Preferences (nickname, volume, streak, igniter, room) live in browser localStorage.
- Aggregate analytics (Vercel + Google Analytics); no ad network or targeted advertising.
- Firebase stores only ephemeral chat and anonymous aggregate counters.
- Selecting a live radio station connects the browser directly to that third-party stream provider, which may receive ordinary connection metadata under its own policy.

### UI / modes
- **Zen Mode** — hides all UI; click anywhere to toggle.
- **Stealth Mode** — reduces visuals; renames the tab for discreet workplace use.
- **High Contrast Mode** — accessibility toggle.
- Language localization (greeting, daily affirmation, chai wording) for 20+ languages via `?lang=`.

---

## Original data (survey) — citable

PuffBreak runs an optional, anonymous micro-survey after each completed break:

> **Question:** "Did this break reduce your craving?"
> **Options:** Gone (😌) / Eased (🙂) / Same (😐) / Worse (😤)
> **Method:** one optional tap after a break; one response per browser session; no accounts, no PII; counts incremented atomically.

- **Human-readable results:** https://puffbreak.app/data
- **Machine-readable JSON:** https://puffbreak.app/api/survey

The aggregate is published unedited. This is self-reported, non-clinical data — a behavioral signal, not medical research.

## Articles (blog)

Long-form articles are published at https://puffbreak.app/blog. Topics include: micro-break science, nicotine craving duration, virtual smoking vs. reality, break-room etiquette, ASMR and stress relief, chai break culture, quitting-smoking support, and digital break-room vs. damta.

---

## Technical architecture

- **Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript.
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4, motion (Framer Motion).
- **Audio:** Web Audio API (procedural synthesis; no ambient files).
- **Particles:** HTML5 Canvas (custom physics engine).
- **Backend:** Firebase Realtime Database (ephemeral chat, presence, aggregate counters).
- **Hosting:** Vercel.
- **PWA:** installable, iOS and Android.
- **Open-source audio engine:** MIT-licensed procedural synthesis (ships with the source).

---

## Frequently asked questions

**Q: Is PuffBreak free?**
A: Yes. Free, no subscriptions, no premium tiers, no ads.

**Q: Do I need an account?**
A: No. It is anonymous — open the URL and start a break. No email, no password.

**Q: Does it collect data?**
A: No personal data. Preferences stay in browser localStorage; analytics are aggregate; the chat is ephemeral. The optional craving survey collects only an anonymous aggregate (one per session).

**Q: Can it help with quitting smoking?**
A: It can serve as a behavioral ritual substitute during the ~3-minute peak of a nicotine craving. It is not a medical device or clinical cessation tool. See the quit-smoking landing page for the honest framing.

**Q: What is the relation to damta (담타)?**
A: Damta is the Korean online "cigarette time" phenomenon. PuffBreak is an English-language continuation with more features (8 rooms, ASMR audio, chai, localization, global chat), not the original Korean site.

**Q: Does it work on mobile?**
A: Yes. Fully responsive, PWA-installable, shake-to-ash supported.

**Q: Is there multiplayer?**
A: It is a shared anonymous space, not a game. Users in a room see a live presence count and an ephemeral chat; there are no accounts or profiles.

**Q: What is the survey data?**
A: An anonymous, optional, one-tap self-report collected after breaks, published unedited at /data and /api/survey. Self-reported and non-clinical.
